guards.guard: og-1: root colouring never implies lexeme/sense sharing; hover wording must say 'same radicals', never 'same meaning'
og-2: surface shape never assigns ownership; root evidence required (v2 rule own-r2-v2)
og-6: consumer output is candidate analysis; it never writes entries, senses or certified facts
method transfers, conclusions do not: the unit's rules apply to new tokens; a specific token's analysis is never copied to another token
